title: Ingress Gateway HTTP 502 Bad Gateway to Order Service
root_cause_summary: Upstream 502 Bad Gateway triggered by order-service pod CPU starvation during sudden order surge. The ingress envoy proxy terminated connections after 15000ms timeout.
remediation_steps: 1. Scale order-service horizontal pod autoscaler (HPA) min replicas from 3 to 8. 2. Increase CPU limit from 500m to 2000m. 3. Adjust ingress upstream idle timeout to 30s.

title: OrderProcessor NullPointerException on Checkout Payload
root_cause_summary: Unhandled exception NullPointerException at OrderProcessor.java:142 occurred because customer checkout payload contained null shipping address fields for guest users.
remediation_steps: 1. Deploy hotfix release adding @NotNull validation and null-safe address fallback in OrderProcessor.java. 2. Reprocess failed orders from dead-letter queue.

title: HikariCP Connection Pool Exhaustion on Payment Database
root_cause_summary: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. An unindexed query on the payment_transactions table locked database threads, starving the pool.
remediation_steps: 1. Terminate long-running locking queries using pg_terminate_backend. 2. Create composite index on payment_transactions(customer_id, created_at). 3. Increase maximumPoolSize from 20 to 50 in application.yml.

title: Redis Cache OOM Out of Memory Crash
root_cause_summary: OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'. Session tokens were stored without expiration TTL, causing redis-server memory consumption to exceed 8GB limit.
remediation_steps: 1. Configure volatile-lru eviction policy in redis.conf (maxmemory-policy volatile-lru). 2. Run emergency script to expire keys older than 7 days. 3. Ensure all session keys include EX 86400 TTL.
error_codes: OOM command not allowed when used memory

title: Kafka Consumer Rebalance Storm on Notifications Group
root_cause_summary: CommitFailedException: Consumer group 'email-notifications' rebalance triggered because batch processing exceeded max.poll.interval.ms (300000ms) during SMTP provider outage.
remediation_steps: 1. Increase max.poll.interval.ms to 600000ms. 2. Reduce max.poll.records from 500 to 50. 3. Wrap SMTP calls in a circuit breaker with asynchronous thread pool delivery.

title: HDFS DataNode SocketTimeoutException Disk Saturation
root_cause_summary: DataNode$DataXceiver: Got exception while serving block blk_1073741825: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: 60000 millis timeout while waiting for channel to be ready for read. Underlying disk I/O utilization reached 100%.
remediation_steps: 1. Replace failing hard drive /dev/sdc on DataNode 10.0.0.14. 2. Trigger HDFS balancer to redistribute data blocks away from saturated nodes. 3. Increase dfs.datanode.socket.write.timeout.

title: Stripe Payment Gateway HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout
root_cause_summary: Payment transaction failed with HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout connecting to https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges. Network latency spike on external transit provider caused gateway requests to time out.
remediation_steps: 1. Enable automatic Stripe idempotency retry with exponential backoff. 2. Trip resilience4j circuit breaker to route transactions through secondary payment processor (Adyen).

title: Istio mTLS Certificate Expiration Causing ETIMEDOUT
root_cause_summary: Connection lost with ETIMEDOUT connecting to auth-service:443. The intermediate CA certificate in Istio Envoy proxy expired, causing strict mTLS handshake failures across the mesh.
remediation_steps: 1. Rotate Istio mesh root CA and restart istiod controller. 2. Run rollout restart deployment for all proxy sidecars. 3. Configure automated cert-manager renewal alert 30 days prior to expiry.

title: Kubernetes OOMKilled Pod Termination Exit Code 137
root_cause_summary: Container search-worker was terminated by Linux kernel cgroup OOM killer (exit code 137). Unbounded in-memory aggregation of 2M documents consumed more than the 4Gi container memory limit.
remediation_steps: 1. Increase pod memory request to 4Gi and limit to 8Gi. 2. Implement pagination and streaming chunking (chunk_size=1000) in document indexer to avoid loading entire collections into RAM.

title: Elasticsearch 429 Flood Stage Disk Watermark Exceeded
root_cause_summary: Elasticsearch cluster rejected write index operations with ClusterBlockException: 429 flood stage disk watermark [95%] exceeded on node elastic-data-2.
remediation_steps: 1. Delete indices older than 30 days via curator/ILM policy. 2. Increase persistent volume claim storage size from 500GB to 1TB. 3. Unlock read-only index block with index.blocks.read_only_allow_delete: null.

title: PostgreSQL Deadlock Detected on Orders and Inventory Tables
root_cause_summary: DeadlockDetected: Process 41258 waits for ShareLock on transaction 891244; Process 41259 waits for ExclusiveLock on relation orders. Two concurrent checkout requests locked rows in opposite order (orders -> inventory vs inventory -> orders).
remediation_steps: 1. Standardize lock acquisition order in transactional code: always acquire inventory locks before order locks. 2. Add client-side transaction retry on SQLSTATE 40P01.

title: Third-Party API HTTP 429 Too Many Requests Rate Limiting
root_cause_summary: FedEx Shipping API returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with header Retry-After: 60. Batch label generation sent 120 req/s, exceeding our tier limit of 50 req/s.
remediation_steps: 1. Implement token bucket rate limiter in ShippingClient capped at 40 req/s. 2. Respect Retry-After header with jittered exponential backoff.

title: JVM Metaspace OutOfMemoryError in Dynamic Classloading
root_cause_summary: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace. JasperReports compiled report templates dynamically into bytecode without unloading classloaders, leaking Metaspace memory until container crash.
remediation_steps: 1. Set JVM flag -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=512m. 2. Enable JasperReports compiled template caching to reuse generated classes across invocations.

title: DNS Lookup ENOTFOUND on Internal CoreDNS Service
root_cause_summary: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND inventory-service.default.svc.cluster.local. CoreDNS pods became unresponsive due to an upstream UDP packet drop under heavy DNS query flood.
remediation_steps: 1. Deploy NodeLocal DNSCache daemonset to cache DNS queries locally on each node. 2. Scale CoreDNS replicas from 2 to 5. 3. Enable TCP fallback for DNS queries.

title: RabbitMQ Delivery Acknowledgement Timeout Precondition Failed
root_cause_summary: Channel closed: PRECONDITION_FAILED - delivery acknowledgement on channel 1 timed out after 1800000 ms. Consumer held unacked message while executing long PDF generation without heartbeat.
remediation_steps: 1. Acknowledge message immediately and offload PDF generation to background worker pool. 2. Configure consumer_timeout = 3600000 in rabbitmq.conf.

title: Cassandra ReadTimeoutException on LOCAL_QUORUM Consistency
root_cause_summary: Cassandra timeout during read query at consistency LOCAL_QUORUM (2 responses were required but only 1 replica responded within 5000ms). Node cassandra-3 was undergoing JVM stop-the-world GC pause.
remediation_steps: 1. Tune Shenandoah/G1 GC flags on Cassandra nodes to cap maximum GC pause under 150ms. 2. Adjust client read_request_timeout_in_ms to 8000ms.

title: SSL Handshake Failed Certificate Expired on Webhook Endpoint
root_cause_summary: SSLHandshakeException: PKIX path validation failed: java.security.cert.CertificateExpiredException: NotAfter: Fri Oct 02 12:00:00 UTC 2026. Target partner webhook endpoint certificate expired.
remediation_steps: 1. Contact partner operations team to renew SSL/TLS certificate. 2. Add pre-flight certificate expiration monitoring in webhook dispatcher to alert before expiration.

title: JWT Signature Verification Failed Due to Server Clock Skew
root_cause_summary: JWTExpiredException: The token is expired (nbf claim in future). NTP synchronization daemon (chronyd) failed on worker node k8s-node-04, causing an 8-minute forward clock drift.
remediation_steps: 1. Restart chronyd service and re-sync hardware clock with AWS NTP pool. 2. Configure JWT validator with 60s clock skew tolerance (withClockSkew(60)).

title: gRPC UNAVAILABLE Upstream Reset Before Response Headers
root_cause_summary: StatusRuntimeException: UNAVAILABLE: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection termination. The user-profile-service gRPC server reached max concurrent streams limit (100).
remediation_steps: 1. Increase NettyServerBuilder.maxConcurrentCallsPerConnection to 1000. 2. Configure keepAliveTime to 30s to detect dead connections proactively.

title: Database Read-Only File System on Amazon RDS EBS Vol
root_cause_summary: OperationalError: could not write to file 'base/16384/pgsql_tmp': Read-only file system. AWS EBS volume underlying PostgreSQL entered degraded read-only state following storage hardware fault.
remediation_steps: 1. Trigger immediate Multi-AZ failover to healthy secondary replica. 2. Terminate and recreate degraded RDS instance storage volume.
